This is a tracking issue for generic associated types (rust-lang/rfcs#1598 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rfcs/pull/1598))

Repository

• Detailed tracking information is available at the GAT initiative repository (https://rust-lang.github.io/generic-associated-types-initiative/)

Unresolved questions:

☑ GATs: Decide whether to have defaults for where Self: 'a #87479 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/87479) -- defaults for where Self: 'a
☑ Proposal: Change syntax of where clauses on type aliases #89122 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/89122) -- where to put where clauses

Blocking bugs

See also the GATs-blocking tag (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AGATs-blocking) (the list below should be a superset of that, but its good to double-check).

☑ lifetime-parametric GATs cause ICEs (with feature(generic_associated_types)) #62521 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/62521)
☐ Associated type projections don't play well with HRTBs and normalization #30472 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/30472) No longer blocking
☑ Pretty printing loses associated type generics and where clauses #67509 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/67509)
☑ Allow generic associate types in trait paths #67510 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/67510)
☑ Generic associated types can shadow lifetimes #67512 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/67512)
☑ Implement type- and const-generic associated types #67513 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/67513)
☑ GAT's arent typechecked, and can cause UB #68641 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68641)
☑ GAT's and broken LLVM #68642 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68642)
☑ GAT ICE: use of PlaceRef { local: _0, projection: [] } before def #68643 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68643)
☑ GAT ICE: Encountered error Unimplemented selecting `Binder #68644 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68644)
☑ GAT ICE: FulfillmentError #68645 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68645)
☑ GAT ICE: impl item and trait item have different parameter counts #68648 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68648)
☑ GAT ICE: place local already assigned to #68649 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68649)
☑ GAT ICE: unsize_thin_ptr: called on bad types #68650 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68650)
☑ GAT ICE: codegen_argument #68652 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68652)
☑ GAT ICE: unelided lifetime in signature #68653 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68653)
☑ GAT ICE: cannot directly store unsized values #68656 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/68656)
☑ Broken LLVM with GAT #74684 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/74684)
☑ [nightly] ICE when using GATs with const generics #75415 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/75415)
☑ ICE when combining GATs and HRTBs #76826 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/76826)
☑ Internal Compiler Error caused by Generic Associated Types #79768 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/79768)
☐ Enum variant with GAT field fails to derive Sized #80626 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/80626) Not GATs specific, not blocking
☑ Error when inferring a lifetime in return type using GATs #81487 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/81487)
☑ Bad diagnostics for GATs in trait paths #81801 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/81801)
☑ defaults on GATs emit an error but function correctlyish #99205 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/99205)

Postponed work

☐ Trait objects do not work with generic associated types #81823 (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/81823)
